A frozen ingest-only unit inspects original sequencing metadata and pinned receiver mechanics before any physical decoding. ENA projects PRJEB19305 and PRJEB19307 list 16 paired MiSeq runs: one master pool, one deep-copy library and two runs at each of seven dilution labels. Their compressed FASTQ files total 95,237,393,879 bytes. The ENA read_count field totals 479,469,649; this metadata sum is not a count of unique synthesized molecules, accepted droplets or decoded messages. No FASTQ was downloaded or decoded in this unit.

Original source is pinned at TeamErlich/dna-fountain commit 8ee2777aa5e9e101e5d756f7e2449f6672b66f1f. Its README uses PEAR stitching, a 152nt fragment-length filter, abundance-descending sorting and removal of sequences containing N. The receiver requires Python2/Cython and unpinned library versions. Its max_hamming comparison operates on byte arrays after Reed-Solomon re-encoding, not directly on nucleotide Hamming distance. These mechanics are not the local bound-nonce decoder or the simplified Fountain reimplementation used in earlier synthetic comparisons.

The original payload hostname fails DNS in this check. A Python3 fork at jdbrody/dna-fountain commit f97c1b8a81f5c5b819209d5b5e26c9c8f4439495 contains a 2,145,290-byte input-file container, but its MD5 differs from the expected encoded-payload MD5 printed in the original recipe. The container contains source files, including a nested archive labelled as a zipbomb example; only its member list was inspected, without extraction or execution. Treating this container as the encoded source bytes would be a provenance error. The original README also specifies 2,116,608 bytes of padding while its decoder parameters imply 67,088 times 32 = 2,146,816 bytes. The 30,208-byte discrepancy remains unresolved, not silently corrected.

Qualification is conditional for read preprocessing and blocked for checksum-certified payload reconstruction until the exact payload and padding/chunk convention are recovered. A physical preprocessing unit could count stitched, length-selected and RS-admissible reads under a separate frozen budget, but cannot call that payload recovery. Neither metadata availability nor an original-author reconstruction would validate this project's modified local codec. Full per-run file sizes and MD5 values, source pins and receiver caveats are retained in results/dna_fountain_source_audit.json. The content-page gate remains uncertified.
Sources: https://github.com/TeamErlich/dna-fountain ; https://github.com/jdbrody/dna-fountain ; ENA projects PRJEB19305 and PRJEB19307, exact portal API URLs retained with the snapshot.
